title: Dual-Inertial Bregman Methods with Energy-Based Safeguarding
summary: We develop dual-inertial Bregman proximal methods for convex optimization and analyze their convergence through an exact signed-drift representation. For unrestarted iterations, one-sided directional curvature control yields a last-iterate $\cO((1+\log k)/k^2)$ rate, improving to $\cO(k^{-2})$ under weighted summability. A computable energy-based safeguard guarantees a global $\cO(N^{-1})$ objective-gap bound, counting all proximal oracle calls.
